MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The smart plug lets me use my existing Alexa devices to control a lamp, adding a useful function to equipment I already own.",
    "A single Blink doorbell feels like a manageable way to check visitors, especially if it works with my Echo Show; it builds on my interest in simple home security."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "More Echo speakers and older Show models duplicate devices I recently bought rather than meet a new need.",
    "The Fire TV recommendations overlap with my recent 4K Max bundle, while the themed remote cover gives me no practical reason to buy another device.",
    "A whole-home camera bundle goes beyond my current interest in trying one doorbell camera."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying Alexa devices seems to have been taken as a reason to keep buying more speakers and displays.",
    "My streaming-device purchase seems to have prompted more similar streaming devices, even though that purchase already met the need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter: I already have a fourth-generation Dot, a second-generation Show 5 with a stand, and a Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle.",
    "Purchases such as my Show stand and replacement Harmony batteries suggest that useful additions supporting equipment I own can make more sense than another main device.",
    "Interest in a simple door alarm does not mean I am ready to install cameras throughout my home."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my Alexa setup but often confuse adding useful capabilities with buying devices that duplicate what I already own."
}
